rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact as MNSO continues to trade at the exact high of its intraday range ($12.12) while the 5-minute 9-EMA has risen from $12.04 to $12.07, tightening support underneath the position. Despite a brief shallow pullback to $12.08 on light volume, buyers stepped back in to push the bid to $12.12, confirming ongoing relative strength against the weak broader market. With the invalidation level firmly protecting downside risk at $12.02, holding allows room for the high-of-day breakout toward the $12.35 target.
